meta.name: experiment-provenance
meta.description: Capture experiment provenance with reproducible run metadata, artifact pointers, and decision logs for scientific claims.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 记录实验来源与可复现元数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在科研中追踪实验来源与决策日志
copy.tagline_en: Capture experiment provenance with reproducible metadata
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to track experiment provenance and decision logs in research

howto.what: 当任务产出可能成为论文声明的证据时，Claude 会记录实验的可复现运行元数据、产物路径和决策日志，并链接到计划文件。
howto.when: 当你提到“track provenance”、“log this experiment”等关键词，或要求记录可复现运行细节时触发。

say.text: 记录这个实验的完整运行元数据。
say.note: Claude 会捕获命令、输入输出路径等。

say.text: 为这个结果添加可复现性日志。
say.note: Claude 会记录验证状态和不确定性。

howto.what_en: When a task produces evidence that may become a manuscript claim, Claude captures reproducible run metadata, artifact pointers, and decision logs, linking them to plan files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "track provenance", "log this experiment", or similar keywords, or ask to record reproducible run details.

say_en.text: Log the full run metadata for this experiment.
say_en.note: Claude captures commands, input/output paths, etc.

say_en.text: Add reproducibility notes for this result.
say_en.note: Claude records validation status and uncertainty.
